title: Ultimate Survival Expansion
description:
This datapack adds 6 legendary swords with unique abilities!
Perfect for players who want a faster and more exciting survival experience!
body:
**_⚔️ Legendary Weapons & Special Abilities_**

Forget standard enchantments. This datapack introduces a dynamic floor-crafting system. To forge these powerful weapons, toss a vanilla sword and the required materials together on the ground and watch them transform!

1. 🪵 The Wooden Sniper (Дървения снайпер)
How to craft: Drop 1 Wooden Sword + 4 Oak Logs together.

The Power: Grants an insane +64 block attack reach (entity_interaction_range) while held in your main hand. Snipe your enemies from across the map before they can even see you.

Enchantments: Sharpness IV, Unbreaking II.

2. 🪨 The Sleeping Lava (Заспиващата лава)
How to craft: Drop 1 Stone Sword + 4 Cobblestone Slabs together.

The Power: Built for ultimate crowd control. Striking an enemy 3 times consecutively triggers a combo that completely freezes them in place, applying Slowness Level 255 for 2 seconds.

Enchantments: Sharpness II, Knockback III.

3. 🟡 Alchemical Abundance (Алхимично изобилие)
How to craft: Drop 1 Golden Sword + 4 Gold Blocks together.

The Power: The ultimate XP farm weapon. While holding it, nearby Experience Orbs give you +5 extra points. Landing a 3-hit combo has a chance to summon a massive XP orb worth 777 points directly at your feet.

Enchantments: Sharpness VI, Looting VI.

4. ⚔️ Akinak (Акинак)
How to craft: Drop 1 Iron Sword + 4 Iron Blocks together.

The Power: The ultimate gladiator tool. Every successful hit instantly heals you (Instant Health I). Additionally, each strike has a 50% random chance to grant you Resistance III for 3 seconds, making you practically unkillable in a pinch.

Enchantments: Sharpness III, Unbreaking III.

5. 🩸 The Crimson Blade (Кърваво острие)
How to craft: Drop 1 Diamond Sword + 4 Emeralds together.

The Power: Inflicts a deadly bleeding effect on your targets. Every hit has a 15% chance to critically wound the enemy, instantly dealing massive damage via Instant Damage I.

Enchantments: Sharpness III, Fire Aspect II, Breach II.

6. 👑 The Ultimate Power (Върховната сила)
How to craft: Drop 1 Netherite Sword + 8 Netherite Blocks together.

The Power: A weapon that scales with your bloodlust. While holding it, you are completely immune to fire (Fire Resistance). Furthermore, every 5 mob or player kills you stack permanently grants you a permanent Strength level increase.

Enchantments: Sharpness IV, Unbreaking III.

**_🛠️ Overhauled & Custom Crafting Recipes_**

Tired of mining for hours? This datapack introduces 8 highly rewarding, customized recipes designed to make rare items accessible directly through your standard 3x3 Crafting Table.

💎 Resources & Blocks
5x Diamonds: Place 5x Sticks in a cross pattern (+) inside the crafting grid.

4x Netherite Ingots: Place 5x Diamonds in a cross pattern, 4x Emeralds in the four outer corners, and 1x Coal right in the dead center.

4x Emerald Blocks: Surround 1x Oak Sapling (center) with 8x Sticks all around it.

2x Iron Blocks: Place 4x Stripped Oak Logs in a cross pattern (+) and 1x Stick in the center.

🏹 Endgame Gear & Tools
The OP Iron Pickaxe: Craft a standard iron pickaxe but completely upside down (3x Cobblestone on the bottom row, 2x Sticks leading up to the top center). This rewards you with a mythical pickaxe pre-enchanted with Efficiency VIII and Fortune III, carrying a clean custom name.

Elytra: Place 4x Feathers in a cross pattern, 4x Wind Charges in the four outer corners, and 1x Netherite Ingot in the center.

The Mace: Place 1x Iron Block in the exact center and 1x Light Blue Stained Glass Pane directly beneath it.

Breeze Rods: Simply place 1x Cobblestone in the center slot of your crafting table to retrieve a Breeze Rod.
